description: This PHP class defines the tlReqMgrSystem class, which is part of the TestLink project. It manages request manager systems, including CRUD operations, linking systems to test projects, fetching system types and implementations, and checking system connectivity. The class interfaces with a database and manipulates system-related data structures.

classes.name: tlReqMgrSystem
classes.description: Manages request system entities within TestLink, allowing creation, deletion, updating, linking to test projects, and retrieving system info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a database connection and populates system types.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Retrieves systems filtered by their enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of system types with interface descriptions.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the implementation interface name for a given system type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the specification of system entity properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new system record in the database after sanitizing inputs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing system record with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a system record if it is not linked to test projects.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a system record by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a system record by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: Generic method to get a system record by attribute key and value.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims input object properties for database safety and consistency.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates or updates a link between a system and a test project.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a link between a system and a test project.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Fetches all test projects linked to a specific system.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Retrieves all system-test project links.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all systems with optional additional info such as link counts.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Retrieves system info linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Instantiates and returns the interface object for a linked system.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if a linked system is reachable/connected.
